name: cut
summary: Extracts columns or characters from each line.
description: Keeps only part of each line: certain fields separated by a delimiter (-d and -f), or certain character positions (-c). Lists are written 1,3 (fields 1 and 3), 2-4 (2 to 4) or 3- (from the 3rd onwards). cut cannot treat several consecutive spaces as a single separator: in that case, use awk.

options.description: Character separating the fields (tab by default).
Character positions to keep: -c1-8 keeps the first 8.
Byte positions to keep (differs from -c for accented characters).
Skips lines that do not contain the delimiter.
Inverts the selection: keeps everything except the given fields.
Separator to use in the output.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to process. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: Lists the user names (1st field, “:” separator).
Keeps columns 2 and 4 of a simple CSV.
Keeps the first 10 characters of each line.
Prints the first directory in the PATH.
